# Profiling and Optimization Techniques
Techniques for production profiling:
- Use `perf` or `samply` on Linux to capture CPU flamegraphs.
- Configure Link-Time Optimization (LTO) and codegen units in `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = true
```
